name: Router

topk.description: number of experts to select per token

reference:
import torch.nn as nn
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(gate_logits, topk):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    probs = F.softmax(gate_logits.float(), dim=-1)
    topk_vals, topk_ids = torch.topk(probs, k=topk, dim=-1)
    return topk_ids, topk_vals.to(gate_logits.dtype)
